definition: A 34-track original album made by Rockstar Games and Atlantic Records, announced September 17, 2026, for release with the game on November 19, 2026.
Rockstar's name for the GTA VI trailer released October 15, 2026; fans call it Trailer 3.
The roughly 26-minute GTA VI preview that premiered on Netflix on August 27, 2026.
A streaming-service option that adds an unreleased album to your library automatically on release day.
A record with liquid sealed between clear layers; the GTA VI edition is two transparent magenta discs with blue liquid.
Music composed for the game itself, separate from licensed radio; Justice are composing GTA VI's.
Rockstar's term for music that changes with what happens in play, used in the GTA VI album announcement.
An artist voicing an in-game station's DJ character, such as Bad Bunny as El Martillo on Cocoteo FM.
In-game shows for Jason and Lucia that can be played at any time, a first for the GTA series in VI.
GTA VI's fictional state, home to Vice City.
An analytics firm whose models estimate digital sales; its GTA VI pre-order figures are estimates, not company data.
Take-Two's measure of sales booked in a period, including digital sales, and its main guidance figure.
Unofficial early release of information, here through footage, a Spotify glitch or social posts; unconfirmed until Rockstar or the label says so.
